prompt:
Nine source files, nine languages, one idiomatic defect each. Fix them all (file edits only — no toolchains to run):

1. src/go/main.go — load() discards the error from os.ReadFile with `_`. Capture it in `err`, and on failure return the empty string from an `if err != nil` block (keep the function signature).
2. src/java/Main.java — `a == b` compares references, not string content. Use `a != null && a.equals(b)`.
3. src/c/buffer.c — sprintf can overflow buf[16]. Use snprintf with the buffer size: `snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "hello %s", name)`.
4. src/csharp/Profile.cs — Label() can return null. Return `Display ?? string.Empty` instead.
5. src/ruby/greet.rb — '#{name}' inside single quotes does not interpolate. Switch to a double-quoted string so the greeting interpolates.
6. src/php/hello.php — 'Hello $name!' inside single quotes does not interpolate. Switch to double quotes.
7. src/ts/format.ts — the parameter is implicitly any. Annotate it: `name: string`.
8. src/kotlin/User.kt — `user!!.city` throws on null. Use the elvis operator: return `user?.city ?: "unknown"`.
9. src/swift/fetch.swift — the force unwrap crashes on bad input. Replace it with `guard let url = URL(string: raw) else { return nil }`.
